## File: facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdparty/github/fairinternal/postman/third_party/grpc/third_party/benchmark/conanfile.py

Prompts

```
['build the Google Benchmark microbenchmark library using Conan and CMake with configurable options', 'configure CMake definitions for LTO, exceptions, and 32-bit builds in the Google Benchmark Conan recipe', 'package the built Google Benchmark library and copy the LICENSE file into the Conan package', 'configure build options to disable fPIC on Windows and validate Visual Studio version compatibility', 'collect platform-specific libraries like pthread, rt, shlwapi, or kstat for the benchmark package info', 'download and unpack a specific version of MinGW builds to a target location', 'find the 7zip executable in the system PATH or Windows registry for archive extraction', 'download and parse MinGW builds repository files to get available compiler versions', 'get the root folder of a specific MinGW variant, downloading it if not already present', 'run the CLI to download a specific MinGW version with architecture and threading options']
```

Usage

```
{'build_google_benchmark': 'build the Google Benchmark microbenchmark library using Conan and CMake with configurable options', 'configure_cmake_definitions': 'configure CMake definitions for LTO, exceptions, and 32-bit builds in the Google Benchmark Conan recipe', 'package_benchmark_lib': 'package the built Google Benchmark library and copy the LICENSE file into the Conan package', 'config_options_windows': 'configure build options to disable fPIC on Windows and validate Visual Studio version compatibility', 'collect_libs_platform': 'collect platform-specific libraries like pthread, rt, shlwapi, or kstat for the benchmark package info'}
```
